subject: Trading
title: Euphoria at the Top
description: A 60-second lesson on Euphoria at the Top.

hook.text: In early 2000, taxi drivers gave stock tips. In late 2021, teens traded crypto on TikTok. Euphoria signals a top.

buildup.text: Market euphoria happens when everyone believes prices can only go up. Risk feels nonexistent.

discovery.text: Sir John Templeton called it: 'Bull markets are born on pessimism, grow on skepticism, mature on optimism.'

twist.text: He finished: '...and die on euphoria.' The final stage feels the best but precedes the worst.

climax.text: When your non-investing friends start bragging about returns, it's the market's way of ringing a bell.

punchline.text: When everyone's a genius, the test is coming.

quiz.question: According to Templeton, when do bull markets die?
options: On euphoria—when everyone believes prices can only rise
